metadata.description: Maps 8 prahar (3-hour time blocks) to recommended ragas based on traditional Indian musicology. Each prahar has primary and secondary raga recommendations with rationale.

prahar_system.description: The day is divided into 8 prahar (watches) of approximately 3 hours each. Each prahar has specific ragas traditionally associated with it based on the emotional and energetic quality of that time.
prahar_system.note: Exact times vary by season and tradition. These represent the standard division.

prahars.name: Pratah Kala (Early Morning)

primary_ragas.name: Mayamalavagowla
primary_ragas.rationale: Traditional beginner raga, auspicious morning scale with powerful awakening quality

primary_ragas.name: Dheerasankarabharanam
primary_ragas.rationale: Major scale equivalent, bright and uplifting for morning energy

primary_ragas.name: Kharaharapriya
primary_ragas.rationale: Versatile raga with natural minor feel, supports morning contemplation

prahars.witness_prompt: As morning light fills the space, notice what awakens within you as these notes rise.

prahars.name: Purvahna (Late Morning)

primary_ragas.name: Harikambhoji
primary_ragas.rationale: Mixolydian equivalent, active and joyful energy for productive morning

primary_ragas.name: Mechakalyani
primary_ragas.rationale: Lydian equivalent with prati madhyama, expansive and luminous

primary_ragas.name: Suryakantam
primary_ragas.rationale: Sun-related raga, intensely bright for peak morning energy

prahars.witness_prompt: At the height of morning energy, observe where your attention naturally flows.

prahars.name: Madhyahna (Afternoon)

primary_ragas.name: Chakravakam
primary_ragas.rationale: Balanced raga that sustains energy without overstimulation

primary_ragas.name: Sarasangi
primary_ragas.rationale: Melodious and sustaining, supports afternoon equilibrium

primary_ragas.name: Kamavardhini
primary_ragas.rationale: Desire-fulfilling raga with prati madhyama, maintains afternoon drive

prahars.witness_prompt: In the fullness of day, notice the balance between doing and being.

prahars.name: Aparahna (Late Afternoon)

primary_ragas.name: Vakulabharanam
primary_ragas.rationale: Sweet and fragrant quality matching late afternoon's softening light

primary_ragas.name: Shanmukhapriya
primary_ragas.rationale: Six-faced beauty raga, complex emotions of day's transition

primary_ragas.name: Gaurimanohari
primary_ragas.rationale: Beautiful and gentle, supports the transition from activity to reflection

prahars.witness_prompt: As the day turns, witness the natural letting go that arises.

prahars.name: Sayam Kala (Early Evening)

primary_ragas.name: Natabhairavi
primary_ragas.rationale: Natural minor, evokes depth and introspection of twilight

primary_ragas.name: Simhendramadhyamam
primary_ragas.rationale: Lion-like raga with Hungarian minor feel, powerful evening meditation

primary_ragas.name: Keeravani
primary_ragas.rationale: Harmonic minor equivalent, deep emotional resonance for evening

prahars.witness_prompt: In the liminal space between day and night, notice what wants to be seen.

prahars.name: Pradosha (Night)

primary_ragas.name: Shubhapantuvarali
primary_ragas.rationale: Deeply contemplative raga with intense inward-turning quality

primary_ragas.name: Jhalavarali
primary_ragas.rationale: Rare and mysterious, suitable for deep night meditation

primary_ragas.name: Hanumatodi
primary_ragas.rationale: Phrygian equivalent, devotional depth for night contemplation

prahars.witness_prompt: In night's stillness, witness the space between thoughts.

prahars.name: Nisha (Late Night)

primary_ragas.name: Kanakangi
primary_ragas.rationale: First raga of the system, represents primordial sound in deepest night

primary_ragas.name: Chalanata
primary_ragas.rationale: Moving dance raga, the finale of the shuddha madhyama set

primary_ragas.name: Rasikapriya
primary_ragas.rationale: Last raga of the system, connoisseur's delight, completes the cycle

prahars.witness_prompt: In the deepest night, rest in the awareness that witnesses even sleep.

prahars.name: Brahma Muhurta (Pre-Dawn)

primary_ragas.name: Jyotiswarupini
primary_ragas.rationale: Light-formed raga, embodies the first stirring of dawn light

primary_ragas.name: Dharmavati
primary_ragas.rationale: Righteous raga, aligns with the sacred pre-dawn hour of dharma

primary_ragas.name: Mayamalavagowla
primary_ragas.rationale: Traditional first raga learned, creates bridge from night to morning

prahars.witness_prompt: In the sacred hour before dawn, witness the birth of a new cycle of awareness.

nakshatra_modulation.description: Nakshatras (lunar mansions) modulate raga selection within each prahar. The ruling planet of the current nakshatra shifts emphasis toward certain swara groups.
